video_title: Jose Alvarado On NBA Finals Competitiveness, Wemby, Jalen Brunson & Reacts To Dolan's 'No-S3x' Joke

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the team's need for Jalen Brunson to stay in the game
quotes.excerpt: We need him to stay in the game.

text_blocks.speaker: DJ Envy
text_blocks.text: When he mushed Jalen, you are from New York. Nobody at the bench wanted to give him a little shove in the chest?

text_blocks.speaker: Jose Alvarado
text_blocks.text: I am not going to lie, we did not even see it. If you really ask anybody on the bench, Jalen cannot do nothing. Not saying that he cannot do nothing or he did not want to do nothing, we need him to stay in the game. It is a basketball thing. There are guys like me, Mitch, and Jordan Clarkson, we have to do something. We did not see that at the moment. If I would have saw it, I think I would have got, not necessarily kicked out, but it would have been like, let us go review it, you know what I am saying? Because that was a little out of pocket.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the emotional impact of Game 4
quotes.excerpt: Game 4 made it so much better.

text_blocks.speaker: Jose Alvarado
text_blocks.text: I was going to be hyped regardless. You look at the last game, I had one rebound and zero points and I turned up. I am celebrating like I was the MVP. But Game 4 made it so much better. You played a crucial role in Game 4. And that energy, that is so much better for me. It just gave me a better, oh, I actually did something for this team or we did something to win the game. So that Game 4 changed everything for me. Mike Brown did a good job. Everybody had to step up. That day was my day and I am just happy it went our way.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the difficulty of guarding Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: I am just trying to keep him off balance as much I can.
quotes.quote: I think he is great, he is a great player, but he is a little goofy to me. You hit him with something and he is just tumbling. I am just trying to keep him off balance as much I can because if you do not, he is going to block it regardless or make you shoot differently. I do not even know how OG was shooting over him consistently good like that. He is an alien for sure.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the team's turnaround during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: We were down 2-1 to the rest of the playoffs.

text_blocks.speaker: DJ Envy
text_blocks.text: What did y'all do to lock in? Because there was a definite pivot from the first round against the Hawks when y'all were down 2-1 to the rest of the playoffs.

text_blocks.speaker: Jose Alvarado
text_blocks.text: I think it was more like the fact of JB did a great job but just being solid the whole time. Our leader and making sure we were locked in, focused, saying the right things. And we also had everybody play the good role. Josh Hart, everybody had a good thing to say and everybody listened to it. And we won one thing, we know we wanted one, that we wanted the championship. So the only way to be on that, we got to be on the straight line and that is what we did.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the team's mindset against the Atlanta Hawks
quotes.quote: They came out hot. They came out and played. There is a lot of pressure for New York. No matter what people say or how people feel, as players you feel it a little bit. So at that moment, they are coming out and making everything. When you play the Knicks, everybody plays good. Role players, the stars, it is just like, we play the Knicks, now we are turning up. So Atlanta was hooping and they were doing a great job. We were in a close game with Atlanta, we should not be. And they had nothing to lose. We had everything else to lose. So, we are in a close game like, we got to close this out. We got to figure it out. It was so staggering that we were trying to figure it out that we were putting so much pressure on ourselves. And then it was time when we had a meeting and it was like, yo, OG, Pat, Ewing talked to us like, listen, we have been here before, let us do this. And after that, we just woke up and we never looked back.
